data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word melos, meaning ‘amiable’ or ‘gracious’. In the New Testament, Melito of Sardes is known as a bishop and an early Christian writer. The name Mellie carries the meaning “Amiable one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mellie usually hope their child will grow to embody amiable one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mellie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Amiable one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mellie total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
